memory_update.text: MP is the reference anchor for domestic rare-earth mine-to-magnet exposure, but it is high-attention and should not dominate the underfollowed lane.
Energy Fuels should be tracked as a rare-earth processor, not only as a uranium name; key survival test is commercial qualification of dysprosium/terbium output and feedstock security.
IperionX is a strong underfollowed candidate for domestic titanium powder/alloy reshoring, with DoD funding as evidence but production ramp and customer qualification still requiring verification.

Materion is a plausible underfollowed advanced-materials supplier where defense and aerospace qualification cycles may be the bottleneck; evidence needs to move from product-market fit to contract or qualified-source proof.

For specialty materials and requalification-dependent inputs, the chokepoint is often the certified processor, alloy maker, coating/filter supplier, or qualified feedstock pathway rather than the mine or the defense prime.

Need follow-up searches for US-listed niche suppliers of samarium-cobalt magnets, gallium/germanium recycling, refractory metals, defense-grade graphite, energetic materials precursors, specialty ceramics, and certified testing/inspection labs.

summary: Expanded the universe for policy-driven specialty materials where reshoring, tariffs, China export controls, defense qualification, or regulated-source traceability can create temporary shortages. The most relevant underfollowed lane is not only miners, but processors, alloy/powder makers, beryllium/coatings suppliers, and rare-earth separation or magnet feedstock qualifiers. This pass includes one reference anchor and three underfollowed or lower-attention US-listed candidates. No buy/sell recommendation is implied.
